def niah_single_3(**kwargs):
    seq_lengths = kwargs.pop("max_seq_lengths", DEFAULT_SEQ_LENGTHS)
    return download_dataset(
        generate_samples(
            get_haystack(type_haystack="essay"),
            max_seq_length=seq,
            template=TEMPLATE,
            type_haystack="essay",
            type_needle_k="words",
            type_needle_v="uuids",
            num_samples=500,
            TOKENIZER=get_tokenizer(**kwargs),
        )
        for seq in seq_lengths
    )
